proposal_design.premise_binding: exact source phrase or whitespace-only equivalent, exact stem phrase, or exact printed-option phrase explicitly marked as hypothetical arithmetic input; exact option clause coverage and exact selected source spans remain mandatory
proposal_design.normalization: collapse whitespace only; preserve all non-whitespace characters, word order, punctuation, numerals, and negation; source quote bytes/locator remain bound
proposal_design.semantic_gate: independent auditor identity; candidate/content/matrix/evidence SHA binding; whole-option and printed-claim review for A-D; unique supported key; contradictions need direct source/stem conflict; source silence remains unresolved and blocks a passing result

limitations: Proposal is not integrated into the frozen resolver or qualification pipeline and provides no release or publication evidence.
The semantic audit is a required input contract; this proposal does not produce academic truth or waive source-silence concerns.
The captured cases are a bounded regression sample, not a full re-audit of the 41-case study.
conclusion: Local regression proposal behaves as intended on the bounded observed matrices and adversarial fixtures. Context paraphrase alone is not a structural citation failure; unsupported/paraphrased premises, altered claims, missing option coverage, forged source spans, unresolved alternatives, and unbound audit hashes fail closed.
